name: Robot Mechanics: Kinematics & Dynamics
summary: The mechanics of robot arms, parallel robots and legged machines: rigid-body motion, forward and inverse kinematics, Jacobians, statics and dynamics.

topics.name: Configuration space, degrees of freedom and workspace
Rigid-body motions: homogeneous transforms, SE(3), twists and screw theory
Forward kinematics: Denavit-Hartenberg and product of exponentials
Velocity kinematics: the Jacobian, singularities and manipulability
Inverse kinematics: analytical and numerical methods
Statics of open chains: wrenches and force transmission
Manipulator dynamics: Newton-Euler and Lagrangian formulations
Trajectory generation: point-to-point motion, time scaling and via points
Closed-chain and parallel mechanisms (Stewart platform, delta robot)
Robot control basics: joint-space, computed-torque, force and impedance control
Kinematics of wheeled mobile robots and legged locomotion
